name: arcade
description: Play mini-games in your browser while Claude works, and get nudged when Claude needs you.

mode.title: Arcade mode
mode.description: alert: pause + banner when Claude needs you; auto: also open the arcade automatically; quiet: status badge only

port.title: Preferred port
port.description: Preferred local port for the arcade server (falls back to the next free ports)

autoOpenDelay.title: Auto-open delay (seconds)
autoOpenDelay.description: Seconds to wait before opening the arcade automatically; used only in auto mode
